subject: Aurora Health - SOC2 evidence & architecture timing
messages:
From: Derek Chen <derek.chen@aurorahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurora Security <compliance@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: SOC2 architecture review & evidence timing

Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well — we’re preparing for an upcoming SOC 2 readiness checkpoint and would like to schedule a technical architecture deep-dive with Redwood to confirm evidence timelines (SSO, KMS/encryption, audit logs, network segmentation). The audit window is mid-November, so we need to lock dates for walkthroughs and evidence handoff.

High-level asks:
- 60–90 minute architecture deep-dive with your security/infra engineers
- Inventory of expected artifacts and an estimated delivery timeline
- Any blockers to providing KMS/SSE details and retention policies

We’re flexible next week (Sep 21–24) and can do mornings ET. I’ve attached our evidence intake template to speed the exchange.

Thanks — Derek
Derek Chen
Lead, Security & Compliance
Aurora Health
Attachment: evidence_intake_template.xlsx (spreadsheet; 42KB)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Derek Chen <derek.chen@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 architecture review & evidence timing

Thanks Derek — appreciate the context and the intake template. I’ve looped in Hannah (security lead) and Aditya (solutions) so we can cover both architecture and artifact delivery.

We can do a 75-minute deep-dive on Tue Sep 21 at 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT or Wed Sep 22 at 10:00 AM ET. Which works best for you?

Pre-call we’ll:
- Share a concise artifact checklist (we’ll attach our SOC2 artifact inventory)
- Prepare a short runbook for KMS/key ownership questions and audit-log retention
- Bring the network/segmentation diagram for the demo environment

If those slots don’t work we can send a calendar poll. Also: are there any specific auditors/tools we should be aware of (eg. them using a portal for evidence ingestion)?

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: Derek Chen <derek.chen@aurorahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurora Security <compliance@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 architecture review & evidence timing

Irene — thanks, Tue 11am ET works for us.

Two quick clarifications before the call:
1) We’ll want a short appendix in the inventory that lists what you can provide: KMS provider (cloud KMS or customer-managed), whether envelope encryption is used, and where audit logs live (retention window / format).
2) Our auditors prefer evidence uploaded to a secure SharePoint folder or a vendor portal; I’ll confirm which tomorrow.

I’ll accept the invite once received. In the meantime I attached a short note from our audit lead on the artifact naming convention.

Thanks — Derek
Attachment: aurora-audit-naming.txt (plain text; 1.2KB)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Derek Chen <derek.chen@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Tue Sep 21, 11:00 AM ET — SOC2 architecture deep-dive

Derek — confirmed and calendar invite sent: https://redwoodinference.app/calendar/meet/irene/aurora-arch-review-20260921

Agenda (75 min):
- 0–10 min: Introductions & objectives (Irene + Derek)
- 10–30 min: Architecture walkthrough (Hannah) — SSO, KMS, encryption-at-rest, audit-log pipelines
- 30–50 min: Evidence mapping & expectations (Aditya) — what we’ll deliver and typical timelines
- 50–65 min: Q&A on retention, log formats, and access controls
- 65–75 min: Next steps & evidence drop procedure

I attached our SOC2 artifact inventory and the network segmentation diagram so you can review before the call. If auditors want a vendor portal upload, we’ll coordinate the export format after the meeting.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-artifact-inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet; 58KB), network-segmentation-diagram.pdf (PDF; 320KB)

See you Tuesday,
Irene Choi
